annotations.title: Turn on a ready-made source for a track

description: Turns on one of TrackerHacker's ready-made sources for a track (from find_hacks with its trackId, under ready): a service that posts to the sheet's link (Shopify, Stripe, GitHub), one TrackerHacker asks on a schedule (a social account's posts), or a reminder that asks the person. Attaches its hacks with the mappings that fill the sheet and returns what the person does next in that service: connect (steps, and a link to paste), webhookUrl, fetch (a scheduled fetch to add with scheduled_fetches, once the person gives what it asks for) or reminder. Call it once the person has said which source.

readyId.description: From find_hacks with this trackId, under ready.
